limits.en: The core local-first app is free and open source; Sync (cloud sync/backup) is only available via a recurring Open Collective contribution during its beta phase.

keyLimits.en: Full local-first app with knowledge graph and outliner; no cloud sync.
Access to Sync (beta) with up to 10 remote graphs per account, 10GB per graph, 100MB per asset file.
Same Sync limits as Backer tier, plus access to Whiteboards, which are Sponsor-only.

cautions.en: Sync access is currently structured as a recurring Open Collective donation during beta, not a standard commercial subscription; Logseq states it plans to move to a normal subscription system once Sync is publicly launched.

capabilities.en: Local-first, open-source personal knowledge management app built around a bidirectional-linking knowledge graph and outliner.
Optional cloud Sync (beta) for multi-device access, with Smart Merge for simultaneous multi-device editing (experimental).

limitations.en: Whiteboards feature is restricted to Sponsor-tier Sync contributors only.
Sync storage is capped at 10 remote graphs per account, 10GB per graph and 100MB per asset file during the beta.
Smart Merge for simultaneous multi-device editing is still experimental and may be unreliable.

reason.en: Direct competitor: local-first, markdown-based PKM tool with a similar plugin/graph ecosystem.
Pioneer of the networked-notes/knowledge-graph category that Logseq is modeled after.
General-purpose note and knowledge tool often compared for PKM workflows.

unknowns: Logseq's open-source license type (e.g. AGPL vs other) was not stated in the page consulted.
Final commercial pricing for Sync once it exits beta is not yet published.
